overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Indiana University Hoosiers football team for winning the College Football Playoff National Championship, the top title in major college football, by beating the University of Miami 27 to 21 on January 19, 2026. It notes that the team finished with a perfect 16-0 record, a first in modern college football history, and that quarterback Fernando Mendoza won the Heisman Trophy. The resolution recognizes the players, coaches, and staff and asks that official copies go to the university's president, athletic director, and head coach. The Senate agreed to it on January 30, 2026.
for: Supporters say the resolution honors a historic, undefeated season that brought pride to the university and the state of Indiana.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
